notes: linked=verified means the email was observed producing a linked contributor in a real repository's Contributors list; documented means an official doc, vendor source code, or community test record exists; inferred means the email is unproven. sources must be checkable: official docs, vendor source files, or concrete community examples. checkedAt is the date the entry was last reviewed, not proof of linkage. A note marks caveats such as community-convention identities that the tool itself does not write. A product can have more than one entry when it writes more than one GitHub identity; name matching prefers the entry whose email equals the trailer's email.
